scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the UTS and UE from the agent's stress-strain curves by re‑implementing the composite model with the (public) phase fractions, Hollomon, and Olson‑Cohen parameters. No fixed hidden gold numbers are needed; the reference is computed on‑the‑fly and compared with tolerances.

outputs.description: Predicted ultimate tensile strength and uniform elongation for the three annealing conditions, to be compared against the paper's hidden reference by the checker.
Engineering stress–strain curves up to the instability point for each annealing condition; the checker recomputes the instability point (max stress) and uniform elongation from these data.

output_contract.notes: Both scored artifacts are derived from the same simulation. The checker will verify that the instability point extracted from stress_strain_curves.csv matches the hidden gold UTS and uniform elongation within tolerances.

steps.description: Recompute UTS/UE from agent's predicted_properties.csv and compare to reference model output.
